scenarios.scenario-1: A conforming project passes the gate with exit 0 and a clean digest.
scenarios.scenario-2: Coverage gaps, lint findings, unreadable indexes and untrusted test requests produce coded findings and the documented exit code.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output and JSON envelopes are asserted by the tests; no runtime log markers are emitted by library modules.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-ci.test.ts (13 tests: coverage checks, gate exit codes, trust refusal exit 2, CLI e2e on the demo project).
notes.note-2: CI is the single gate referenced by ROADMAP release checklist G3/G4/G5 and by AGENTS.md commands.
